chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, from Bakr ibn Ḥabīb, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
“There is no harm in the water of the bathhouse if it has a supply source.”

key_terms.الْحَمَّامِ: the bathhouse; a public bathing place
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection
key_terms.مَادَّةٌ: a supplying source or continuous feeder of water

ai.seo_question: Is bathhouse water permissible to use if it has a continuous source?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the purity and use of bathhouse water. It states that such water is unobjectionable when it is connected to a continuing source of water.
